## Variables

### Form

```ts
const Form: ForwardRefExoticComponent<
  object & FormHTMLAttributes<HTMLFormElement> & RefAttributes<HTMLFormElement>
>;
```

A form with Caps' field rhythm. While `busy`, its fieldset disables every
control and the form reports `aria-busy`; validation stays with the caller.

### NumberField

```ts
const NumberField: ForwardRefExoticComponent<
  object &
    Omit<
      InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement>,
      "defaultValue" | "onChange" | "type" | "value" | "max" | "min" | "step"
    > &
    RefAttributes<HTMLInputElement>
>;
```

A number spinbutton: a native `input type="number"` between − and + keys, with
the value as a mono readout. Field wires its label, description and error to the
input. The `caps-number-field-*` parts are stable so a context such as a Screen
can redraw them; the semantics stay here.
